opportunities.title: Training Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All members of the Genetics Society can apply, as long as you are studying or working in the UK, or the course you wish to attend is being held in the UK. Students can apply as soon as they become Society members; others should be a Society member for at least one year.
opportunities.summary: Grants of up to £1,200 to enable members to attend formal short training courses or a collaborative visit to another laboratory to train in specific genetic/genomic techniques.

opportunities.title: Junior Scientist Conference Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Scheme A: undergraduate, Master’s and PhD student members and postdoctoral members within six years of PhD viva. Schemes B & C: PhD student and postdoctoral members within six years of PhD viva.
opportunities.summary: Supports attendance of Genetics Society junior scientist members at conferences, with travel, accommodation and registration costs covered up to £750 depending on scheme.

opportunities.title: Heredity Fieldwork Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All members of the Genetics Society can apply, as long as you are studying or working in the UK, or you intend to carry out your fieldwork in the UK.
opportunities.summary: Awards up to £2,000 (usually below £1,700) to cover travel, accommodation, subsistence and consumables for field‑based genetic research projects.

opportunities.title: Public Engagement Grant
opportunities.summary: Grants of up to £1,000 to support public engagement activities related to genetics, covering eligible travel and material costs.

opportunities.title: One‑off Meeting Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members may apply at any time; applications are encouraged at least three months before the event.
opportunities.summary: Sponsorship of genetics‑themed one‑off meetings not organised directly by the Society, with support levels ranging from a few hundred pounds to several thousand pounds.

opportunities.title: Special Interest Group Funding
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Genetics research communities wishing to run regular series of meetings; applicants are expected to be members of the Society.
opportunities.summary: Funding up to £2,000 per year to support regular meetings of new Special Interest Groups in genetics, covering travel, accommodation, publicity and other direct meeting costs.
